dedupe_keys.name: cadre harmonise and ipc food security data for west and central africa

description: This dataset compiles the results of the Cadre Harmonise, the regional food insecurity classification that West African and Sahel governments run twice a year under the coordination of CILSS, together with IPC analyses for Central African countries. The Food Security and Nutrition Working Group for West and Central Africa publishes the tables and maps on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is up to 19 countries listed on the dataset, from 2014 to the latest cycle, with populations in phases 1 to 5 for current (March to May or October to December) and projected (June to August) periods at first and second administrative level; the February and March 2026 cycle covered only four countries because of budget limits. Resources include an Excel table, GeoJSON boundaries with phase results and PDF maps, free under the Creative Commons Attribution licence and updated each cycle. Caveats: country coverage varies between cycles, administrative units change, projected figures are scenarios, and some areas are not analysed because of insecurity. Simulation uses: defining vulnerable populations and demand for food assistance in food supply chain disruption models, targeting humanitarian logistics, and building drought or conflict scenarios for the Sahel. Related records: the IPC acute food insecurity country data (data-ipc-acute-food-insecurity-country-data) cover other regions with the same phase scale, and WFP global food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices) give market signals.
